name: @askviraj/claude-status
description: A fast powerline status line for Claude Code
author: Viraj Patel
//: macOS only — `os` makes npm refuse the install elsewhere rather than failing at run time. The BINARY is not in this package: it is a GitHub release asset that `--install` downloads and verifies against bin/checksums.json, which `mise run build:installer` generates from the target table in .config/mise/tasks/_scripts/_rust. `version` here is this PACKAGE's version and is hand-set — it is deliberately NOT substituted from Cargo.toml while the package and the binary are on separate version lines; the binary release to fetch is named by checksums.json. Adding a platform means that table, this `os` field, and a build matrix entry in .github/workflows/release.yml.
